title: Claim A: the pairing of u − u∗φ with a smooth test function bounded by 1 is at most sV
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R, s, V ∈ ℝ with R > 0, s > 0, 2s < R and V ≥ 0, let φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ be smooth with φ ≥ 0, tsupport φ ⊆ B_s(0) and ∫φ = 1, and let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on B_{2R}(0) (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with Lebesgue measure). Assume |∫_{B_{2R}(0)} u(y)·Df(y)(z) dy| ≤ V‖z‖M for every smooth compactly supported f : ℝⁿ → ℝ with tsupport f ⊆ B_{2R}(0), every z ∈ ℝⁿ and every M ∈ ℝ with |f| ≤ M everywhere. Let g : ℝⁿ → ℝ be smooth with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ B_{R+s}(0) and |g(x)| ≤ 1 for all x. Then |∫_{ℝⁿ} (u(x) − w(x))·g(x) dx| ≤ sV, where w(x) := ∫_{B_{2R}(0)} u(y)φ(x − y) dy.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R s V : ℝ) (φ u g : Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < R → 0 < s → 2 * s < R → 0 ≤ V → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ φ y) → tsupport φ ⊆ ball 0 s → ∫ y, φ y = 1 → IntegrableOn u (ball 0 (2 * R)) → (∀ (f : Euclid n → ℝ) (z : Euclid n) (M : ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ ball 0 (2 * R) → (∀ y, |f y| ≤ M) → |∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ V * ‖z‖ * M) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ ball 0 (R + s) → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) → |∫ x, (u x - ∫ y in ball 0 (2 * R), u y * φ (x - y)) * g x| ≤ s * V
